name: Zowie
tagline: Zowie is an AI customer service platform built specifically for e-commerce brands. It automatically resolves common customer queries about orders, returns, and shipping, and escalates complex issues to human agents. It integrates natively with Shopify, Zendesk, and Gorgias.
